purpose: Define what a later feature/model promotion would require after the original holdout was opened.

development_design.outer_training: Expanding weeks 0 through the week immediately preceding each outer window.
development_design.inner_windows: Within each outer training population, use the last two disjoint four-week windows as chronological inner validation windows, each with expanding prior training. Refit candidate screens, encoders, calibration and all learned transforms inside each inner training window.
development_design.candidate_registration: Hash the exact feature/model candidates, seeds, raw snapshots, availability contracts and search budget before launching. No candidate changes after reading outer results.
development_design.selection: Choose on mean inner weekly Gini stability, then worst inner stability, then fewer features. Derive boosting budgets from the selected inner fits; no outer early stopping.
development_design.outer_evaluation: One prediction pass for the selected inner procedure on each outer window. Pool only aligned cases; report all five folds and all six registered comparison diagnostics.
development_design.interpretation: Nested development estimate of the specified selection procedure. Prior exploratory use of these weeks remains disclosed; this is not a new untouched external test.

release_requirements: New independent labeled application periods or a genuinely independent external evaluation population, with target maturity and feature availability established.
Freeze features, encoders, parameters, weights and calibration before independent labels are accessed.
Validate raw train/test parity, native bundle lineage, resource bounds, schema and probability contracts for every promoted feature.
Report original and proposed models on identical independent cases, with dependence-aware uncertainty and no adaptive test reuse.
current_release_action: Retain the frozen evaluated release. Research gate completion is not permission to claim a newly validated model.
